name: DateRangePicker
description: Start/end date range with ISO strings and quick presets.
designIntent: Dashboards filter by rolling periods and custom date ranges. DateRangePicker provides an ISO contract and preset shortcuts while using the native date fields for keyboard and platform behavior.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled range with ISO start/end strings.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next ISO range.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the start field.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the end field.

props.name: presets
props.description: Preset buttons. Defaults to 7 days, 30 days, 90 days and YTD.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the preset buttons and both date fields.

examples.title: Rolling range
examples.code:
<DateRangePicker
  value={range}
  onValueChange={setRange}
  presets={[
    { label: '7 days', days: 7 },
    { label: 'YTD', ytd: true },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: A controlled range with two presets.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a single date field for a range
antiPatterns.explanation: A range needs two independent ends. Use DateRangePicker so partial ranges and ordering are handled.

accessibility.implementation: Each native date input has a visible associated label
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the From/To labels or override them with the domain terms

accessibility.implementation: The end cannot precede the start; changing the start past the end moves the end
accessibility.userRequirements: Use ISO dates in the value contract

compositionRules.relationship: Place DateRangePicker inside a FilterPanel section
